plans.description: The injected fault set both animateTransform elements to begin="indefinite", so the structure test fails with animation_not_started:rider-bob and the browser reports moving:false for both groups. Restore automatic start on both animations without touching artwork or timing.
plans.goal: For each of the two animateTransform elements (id="horse-gallop" and id="rider-bob"), replace the exact attribute text begin="indefinite" with begin="0s". Leave dur="1.2s", repeatCount="indefinite", values, keyTimes, and all sibling drawing elements unchanged. Then run wukong.verify to confirm structure passes and both white-dragon-horse and wukong report moving:true.

plans.description: Alternative to a fixed offset: bind the animations to document load so they start as soon as the SVG is parsed, still using the same 1.2s cycle and target groups.
plans.goal: On both animateTransform elements, replace begin="indefinite" with begin="0s;wukong-title.click" is not needed; instead use begin="0s" plus an explicit SMIL start is unnecessary. Concretely: change begin="indefinite" to begin="0s" on horse-gallop and rider-bob only. Do not alter any path, gradient, viewBox, or the 1.2s duration. Verify with wukong.verify that structure passes and both groups move.

plans.description: If a plain begin="0s" is not honored by the test harness, add a lightweight SVG onload start fallback that calls beginElement() on both animations, preserving the existing indefinite begin attribute value semantics only as a fallback path.
plans.goal: First change begin="indefinite" to begin="0s" on both animateTransform elements. If wukong.verify still reports animation_not_started, add an onload attribute to the root <svg> that calls document.getElementById('horse-gallop').beginElement() and document.getElementById('rider-bob').beginElement(), keeping all artwork, durations, and animation targets identical. Re-run wukong.verify until structure passes and both white-dragon-horse and wukong report moving:true.
